extraction_metadata.extraction_notes: Novo Nordisk trial NN9536-4373, protocol v2.0 section 2 "Flowchart". Pages are landscape content on portrait pages (rotated 90 degrees). Text layer present; marks binned by pdftotext -bbox against column boundaries recovered from raster rule lines (200 dpi). Header rows reprint on every page and were de-duplicated. The visit-label token "V20P21V22" is a single text-layer token and was split into V20/P21/V22 by the rule-line column boundaries and the week row (52/56/60). Inline section/appendix references stripped from activity names into source_note annotations pr1..pr30.

table_metadata.table_purpose: Main schedule of activities for the whole trial (screening, randomisation, dose escalation, maintenance, end of treatment, end of trial)
table_metadata.notes: Single printed table running over six pages under a reprinted header; extracted as one table (not continuations). Label columns L=1; data columns 2-26 (25 visits).

schedule_properties.property_comment: Top header band with an empty label cell: Screening, Randomisation, Dose escalation period (merged over V3-V10), Maintenance period (merged over P11-P23), End of treatment, End of trial. Major study phases -> epoch. Name synthesised.
Visit identifiers V1-V25; prefix V = site visit, P = phone contact. Named visits -> visit.
Nominal timing of each visit in weeks relative to randomisation (-1 to 75). Week numbers -> week.
Allowed visit window in days (-7 to 0, ±0, ±3, 0 to +5). Tolerances -> window; values repeat across columns so the row does not distinguish columns (level null).

annotations.annotation_text: Demography consists of date of birth, sex, ethnicity, and race (according to local regulation).
Smoking is defined as smoking at least one cigarette or equivalent daily.
DEXA scan is performed in a sub-population.
DEXA scan should be performed in fasting state prior to randomisation (after informed consent is obtained).
Only for subjects where the separate informed consent for future research has been signed.
Fasting at V25 is defined as at least 2 hours without food and drink intake except water before attending the visit.

review_items.call_made: PHQ-9 and C-SSRS (page 11) are recorded as children (level 2) of the "Clinical Outcome Assessments (9.4.1)" group row, based on their light (child-row) shading and position under that group, although their text indent equals that of level-1 rows.
review_items.alternative: Record them at level 1, siblings of the group row, following the text indent alone.

review_items.call_made: Visit Window for V2 is recorded as "±0", as printed on pages 8, 9, 10, 12 and 13; page 11 prints "0" in the same cell.
review_items.alternative: Record "0" (the page 11 reading), or treat the two as equivalent and note only.

review_items.call_made: The unlabeled top header band is typed epoch and named "Study period" (synthesised), with "Randomisation" treated as one of its values alongside Screening, Dose escalation period, Maintenance period, End of treatment and End of trial.
review_items.alternative: Type the band as period, or treat Randomisation / End of treatment / End of trial as visit-level labels rather than epochs.
